build_agglomerative_clustering: build an agglomerative clustering model using ward linkage to group samples into clusters
test_agglomerative_clustering_fit_predic: test AgglomerativeClustering fit_predict to get cluster labels for each sample
build_ward_tree: build a hierarchical clustering tree using ward linkage with optional connectivity and distance output
build_linkage_tree: build a linkage tree using complete, average, or single linkage with optional connectivity matrix
build_feature_agglomeration: build a FeatureAgglomeration transformer to reduce features by hierarchical clustering
